title: Norm Macdonald on Germany
summary: Norm Macdonald's 2015 appearance on Letterman's final Late Show, delivering a deadpan bit about Germany and its military history. Jerry Seinfeld reportedly called it Norm's best joke.
why: HN shares it as one of the greatest stand-up bits ever, and pulls it out whenever Germany, war or trade come up.

quote.text: will easily go down as one of the greatest stand-up bits ever written and performed
